design_detail: Illustrative 5% wealth tax on the richest Slovaks
quote_original: Keby sa zaviedla daň z bohatstva iba na úrovni 5 %, iba prvá trojica na slovenskom rebríčku najbohatších by za vlaňajší rok odviedla do rozpočtu viac ako 203 miliónov eur.
quote_en: If a wealth tax of only 5% were introduced, the top three on the Slovak rich list alone would have paid more than 203 million euros into the budget last year.
source_title: Konsolidácia podľa Ódora, Fica a Šimečku
grading_note: Her own commentary: she names a wealth tax, computes its yield on the 45 richest Slovaks and asks Slovak millionaires to join the Patriotic Millionaires; the 5% rate is an illustration, not a worked proposal, so grade B.

design_detail: Shift taxation from work to wealth; no asset base or design specified
quote_original: Daňový systém nastavíme tak, aby menej zaťažoval prácu a viac bohatstvo.
quote_en: We will set the tax system so that it taxes work less and wealth more.
source_title: Program politickej strany DOBRÁ VOĽBA 2020
grading_note: Party’s own 2020 manifesto calls for taxing wealth more than work but does not identify a net-wealth tax base. The nearby dividend proposal changes corporate and personal dividend taxes; wording remains ambiguous and grade C.

design_detail: Tax on assets proposed in response to wealth concentration; precise tax base unspecified
quote_original: Ak je problémom pre spoločnosť koncentrácia bohatstva, je na mieste daň z majetku.
quote_en: If the concentration of wealth is a problem for society, a tax on assets is appropriate.
source_title: Mýty a fakty o daňovo-odvodovom zaťažení na Slovensku
grading_note: Direct quotation attributed to Profant, supplied to the author by email. Links tax on assets to concentrated wealth, but Slovak majetková daň can include real estate alone; grade C pending a defined tax base.
